z-m-13-03.title: Mvura ye 3/4 L, mabhodhoro e 1/6 L: ngano ipi inokodzera?
z-m-13-03.topic: Kupatsanura ma fractions: kusarudza ngano inokodzera mutsara nekugadzira zviitiko apo zvinozadza pasina chinosara
z-m-13-03.goal: Taura kana ngano ichienderana ne fraction ÷ fraction zvichireva "kuti imwe huwandu hunokwana kangani mune humwe," gadzira iwe pachako zviitiko apo zvinozadza pasina chinosara, uye kana quotient i fraction, verenga nhamba chaiyo yemabhodhoro kuti ienderane nemubvunzo.
z-m-13-03.material: Seoyeon anoda kugadzira ngano inokodzera kupatsanura fraction 3/4 ÷ 1/6. Panogona kuva nengano imwe chete kana dzakawanda dzinokodzera mutsara umwechete. Kutanga uchasarudza yakarurama pakati pengano ina, wozogadzira ngano iwe pachako.
z-m-13-03.thinking.2: Kuverenga mutengo we quotient nenhamba chaiyo inodiwa sezvinhu zvakasiyana
z-m-13-03.prereq.0: Ruzivo rwekufunga nezvekupatsanura se "kuti imwe huwandu hunokwana kangani mune humwe"
z-m-13-03.prereq.1: Zvinoreva ma fractions nema irreducible fractions (padanho regiredhi re5)
z-m-13-03.s.s1.prompt: Seoyeon anoda kugadzira ngano inokodzera 3/4 ÷ 1/6. Ngano ipi ine mutengo wemutsara uyu semhinduro? (3/4 i matatu emana, uye 1/6 i rimwe rechitanhatu.)
z-m-13-03.s.s1.hint.0: Pangano imwe neimwe, nyora kuti 3/4 ne 1/6 imwe neimwe inomirira huwandu hupi.
z-m-13-03.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa imwe neimwe kuti ngano inobvunza here kuti 1/6 inokwana kangani mu 3/4.
z-m-13-03.s.s1.o.a: Kana vanhu 6 vachigoverana 3/4 L yemvura zvakaenzana, mugove wemunhu mumwe
z-m-13-03.s.s1.r.a: Iyi i ngano yekugovera mvura zvakaenzana nevanhu 6 (3/4 ÷ 6). 1/6 haisi nhamba yevanhu asi huwandu mubhodhoro rimwe.
z-m-13-03.s.s1.o.b: Kana ukamwa 1/6 ye 3/4 L yemvura, huwandu hwawakamwa
z-m-13-03.s.s1.r.b: Iyi i ngano inobvunza kuti 1/6 ye 3/4 i yakawanda sei (3/4 × 1/6). Haibvunzi kuti 1/6 inokwana kangani mu 3/4.
z-m-13-03.s.s1.o.c: Kana ukadururira 3/4 L yemvura mumabhodhoro e 1/6 L, nhamba yemabhodhoro
z-m-13-03.s.s1.o.d: Kana ukabatanidza 3/4 L yemvura ne 1/6 L yemvura, huwandu hwese
z-m-13-03.s.s1.r.d: Iyi i ngano yekubatanidza huwandu hwaviri (3/4 + 1/6). Haibvunzi kuti huwandu humwe hunokwana kangani mune humwe.
z-m-13-03.s.s1.explain: Ngano inobvunza kuti 1/6 L inokwana kangani mu 3/4 L inokodzera 3/4 ÷ 1/6. Mutengo i 9/2, ndiko kuti, 4 ne 1/2. Kupatsanura kunogona kuratidzwa nemhando mbiri dzengano, "kugovera zvakaenzana" (partitive) ne "kuti huwandu hunokwana kangani mune humwe" (quotative), uye sezvo 1/6 mumutsara uyu i huwandu mubhodhoro rimwe, kwete nhamba yevanhu, mhando yechipiri yengano inokodzera.
z-m-13-03.s.s2.prompt: Panguva ino, gadzira ngano sa Seoyeon. Unoda kuzadza mabhodhoro e 1/c L (c i denominator yebhodhoro rimwe) zvakazara nemvura ye n/d L (numerator n, denominator d), pasina chinosara. Mvura i irreducible fraction diki kupfuura 1 L, d i 12 kana kushoma, uye c i natural number kubva ku 2 kusvika ku 12. Unoda mabhodhoro 2 kana kupfuura. Gadzira zviitiko zvitatu zvakasiyana.
z-m-13-03.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza huwandu hwemvura, chinja hukuru hwebhodhoro, uye uverenge kuti huwandu mubhodhoro rimwe hunokwana kangani mumvura.
z-m-13-03.s.s2.hint.1: 3/4 L ne 1/6 L hazvina kuzadza mabhodhoro zvakazara. Tarisa kuti hukuru hwebhodhoro hwakadini hwaizokwana chaizvo.
z-m-13-03.s.s2.ok.c1: n, d, ne c i natural numbers mumarange akarurama.
z-m-13-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota ita n natural number ye 1 kana kupfuura, d i 12 kana kushoma, uye c kubva ku 2 kusvika ku 12.
z-m-13-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Mvura i irreducible fraction diki kupfuura 1 L.
z-m-13-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Huwandu hwemvura n/d haisi irreducible fraction diki kupfuura 1 L.
z-m-13-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Pane mvura inosara. Verenga kuti 1/c inokwana kangani muhuwandu hwemvura uye utarise kana i natural number.
z-m-13-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Bhodhoro rimwe rinokwana. Edza kuita bhodhoro diki (ita c yakakura).
z-m-13-03.s.s2.explain: Nhamba yenguva dzinokwana 1/c muhuwandu hwemvura n/d i n×c÷d. Mutengo uyu unofanira kuva natural number kuti mabhodhoro azadzwe zvakazara. Semuenzaniso, 3/4 L mumabhodhoro e 1/4 L i mabhodhoro 3, 2/3 L mumabhodhoro e 1/3 L i mabhodhoro 2, uye 1/2 L mumabhodhoro e 1/6 L i mabhodhoro 3. 3/4 L mumabhodhoro e 1/6 L i mabhodhoro 4 nehafu yebhodhoro, saka haizadzi zvakazara.
z-m-13-03.s.s3.prompt: 3/4 ÷ 1/6 = 9/2, ndiko kuti, 4 ne 1/2. Unoda kudururira mvura yese ye 3/4 L mumabhodhoro e 1/6 L. Bhodhoro rakazara hafu chete rinoverengwabe sebhodhoro rimwe. Ndiangani mabhodhoro anodiwa pashoma?
z-m-13-03.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora nemashoko kuti 4 ne 1/2 mu quotient 4 ne 1/2 imwe neimwe inoreva chii kumabhodhoro.
z-m-13-03.s.s3.hint.1: Tsvaga kana pane mvura inosara mushure mekuzadza, uye uverenge kana bhodhoro rimwe rinodiwa kumvura iyoyo.
z-m-13-03.s.s3.r.b: 4 inoverenga mabhodhoro akazara chete. Unoda bhodhoro rimwe rakawanda kumvura inosara ye 1/12 L.
z-m-13-03.s.s3.r.c: Bhodhoro i chinhu chausingagone kucheka kuita zvidimbu. Unofanira kufunga zvakasiyana nezvemutengo wenhamba (quotient) nenhamba chaiyo yemabhodhoro anodiwa.
z-m-13-03.s.s3.r.d: 9 i numerator ye quotient 9/2. Unofanira kuverenga fraction se 4 ne 1/2 wobva wasarudza nhamba yemabhodhoro.
z-m-13-03.s.s3.explain: Quotient 4 ne 1/2 inoreva mabhodhoro 4 akazara nehafu yebhodhoro imwe. Mvura inosara i 3/4 − 4×1/6 = 1/12 L (huwandu hwehafu yebhodhoro), uye bhodhoro rinodiwawo kwairi, saka ese i mabhodhoro 5. Kana mubvunzo uchiti "mabhodhoro mangani akazara," i 4, uye kana uchiti "mabhodhoro mangani anodiwa," i 5. Quotient imwechete inoverengwa zvakasiyana zvichienderana nemubvunzo.

z-m-13-06.title: Kana vanhu 5 vachigovana makeke 2, munhu mumwe nemumwe anowana zvimedu zvingani?

z-m-13-06.goal: Siyanisa kuti mhinduro yekugovanisa nhamba dzakazara inogona kunyorwa sechidimbu (huwandu) uye kuti kuitaura nezvimedu, unoda kuziva zvakawanda nezvekucheka, wana nyaya dzinogovanisika pasina chinosara, uye ufunge nzira dzakasiyana dzekugadzirisa nyaya dzisingagoverwi.

z-m-13-01.title: "Akanwa 2/5." Ndi L zvingani izvozvo?
z-m-13-01.topic: Mibvunzo yenyaya yekuwedzera fractions: kuverenga kana fraction ine "huwandu" kana "chikamu chechose"
z-m-13-01.goal: Cherechedza kuti mhinduro inochinja zvichienderana nekuti fraction isina unit inoreva "huwandu hwakadaro" kana "chikamu chimwe chechose," gadzira iwe pachako nyaya apo kuverenga kuviri kunosiyana zvikuru, uye unyore zvakare mutsara kuti uverengwe nenzira imwe chete.
z-m-13-01.material: Sujin akanwa 2/5 (two fifths) yemvura ye3/4 L (three fourths of a liter) yaiva mubhodhoro remvura. Mudzidzisi akabvunza, "Mvura yasara ndi L zvingani?" Eunu akapindura 3/4 − 2/5 = 7/20 L, uye Harin akapindura 3/4 × 3/5 = 9/20 L. Vaviri vakaverenga mutsara mumwe chete ndokuwana mhinduro dzakasiyana. (Pakutanga bhodhoro raiva ne3/4 L chete, uye hapana mvura yakawedzerwa paaikunwa.)

Eunu naHarin vega vakasarudza dudziro imwe, uye mukati medudziro yavo kuverenga kwakarurama. Kuti usarudze imwe chete, unofanira kuziva kuti 2/5 ndeyei.

z-m-13-04.s.s1.st.2.after: 3/4 ÷ 3/8 = 2 uye 2 ÷ 2/5 = 5. Zvakanga zvakarurama kuti pakanga pasina mabrackets, asi chakanga chakaipa i × yakadhindwa. Kutonga kwekutanga kwe 4/5 kwakanga kwakarurama pamutsara wakadhindwa uye kwakanga kusina kururama kubhuku remhinduro. z-m-13-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Waverenga kusvika chete ku 3/4 ÷ 3/8 wogumira. Unofanira kupatsanura quotient iyoyo 2 ne 2/5 kamwe zvakare.
z-m-13-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Waverenga chete chikamu chekupedzisira 3/8 ÷ 2/5. Kupatsanura kwekutanga ne 3/4 kusipo.
z-m-13-04.s.s1.reflect: Kutonga kwako kwekutanga (i 4/5, kana hazvigoni kusarudzwa) kwakachinja sei nguva imwe neimwe wakaona ruzivo rutsva? Ruzivo rupi rwakachinja kutonga kwako, uye rupi rwakachinja chete kuvimba kwako? Ungaita chii kudzikisa zvikanganiso pakudhinda?
z-m-13-04.s.s2.prompt: Unoda kuedza nemutsara wakadhindwa wakanyorwa se 3/4 ÷ 3/8 × p/q. Gadzira ma p/q maviri apo mutengo unoverengwa nenzira yakatevedzana kubva kuruboshwe nemutengo kana ukaverenga 3/8 × p/q yekupedzisira kutanga zvakasiyana. (p ne q i natural numbers kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 20, uye uverenge ma fractions ane mutengo mumwechete kamwe chete.)
z-m-13-04.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza p/q imwe uye utsvage mutengo unoverengwa kubva kuruboshwe nemutengo kana chikamu chekupedzisira chaverengwa kutanga.
z-m-13-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kana pane p/q apo mitengo yakabuda yakaenzana, tarisa kuti ine chimiro chakadini, uye usarudze zvakare uchidzivirira chimiro chiyero.
z-m-13-04.s.s2.ok.c1: p ne q i natural numbers kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 20.
z-m-13-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota ita p ne q natural numbers kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 20.
z-m-13-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Mitengo yekuverenga kuviri yakafanana. Chinja p/q uye utsvage mitengo miviri uye uienzanise.
z-m-13-04.s.s2.explain: Kana uchiverenga kubva kuruboshwe, 3/4 ÷ 3/8 = 2 uye 2 × p/q = 2p/q. Kana ukaita product yekupedzisira kutanga, 3/4 ÷ (3/8 × p/q) = 2q/p. Mitengo miviri yakafanana chete kana p = q, ndiko kuti, p/q = 1. Semuenzaniso, kana p/q = 2/5, dzinosiyana: 4/5 ne 5.
z-m-13-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Mu 3/4 ÷ 3/8 × p/q, p/q i nhamba yemhando ipi kana mitengo yekuverenga kuviri ichienzana? Shandisa nhamba dzemienzaniso yawakaedza kamwe chete kana kupfuura, uye unyore fungidziro yako.
z-m-13-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Isa ma fractions akasiyana mu p/q, uye urongedze patafura ine makoramu maviri kuti ndeapi anoita kuti kuverenga kuviri kupe mutengo mumwechete uye ndeapi anoita kuti dzisiyane.
z-m-13-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Enzanisa ma fractions akabuda akafanana nemaakabuda akasiyana, uye utsvage chimiro chavanoverengeka.
z-m-13-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakawana mitengo yose miviri mumienzaniso yawakapa uye wakaienzanisa here?
z-m-13-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakaedza nemimwe mienzaniso kuti pane chiitiko chimwe chete here apo dzinoenzana?
z-m-13-04.s.s2.because.model.0: Dzakafanana chete kana p/q i 1. Kana ukaisa 2/2 kana 3/3, mitengo yose miviri inobuda i 2. Kana ukaisa 2/5 kana 3/4, dzinosiyana, sa 4/5 ne 5.
z-m-13-04.s.s2.because.model.1: Kuverenga kuviri kwakafanana chete kana numerator nedenominator zvaienzana, ndiko kuti, pafraction ine mutengo 1. 2/5 ne 3/4 dzakasiyana.

z-m-13-07.goal: Tsanangura, uchishandisa hukama pakati pemadhesimali nezvidimbu, kuti nei nzira yekuchinja kuwanza nedhesimali kuita kugovanisa ichishanda, wana madhesimali anoshanda, uye uedze nyaya dzisingashande nenhamba kuti usarudze huwandu hwekuwedzera kwakazara.
z-m-13-07.material: Raon akaverenga 7.2 × 0.25 saizvi. "0.25 i1/4, saka ndinogona kungogovanisa 7.2 ne4. 7.2 ÷ 4 = 1.8!" Apo 7.2 × 0.25 yakaverengwa chaizvo nenzira yakamira, yakabudawo 1.8. Raon akati nemufaro, "Ndinofunga kuwanza kwose nedhesimali kunogona kuchinjwa kuita kugovanisa saizvi!" (7.2 inoverengwa se"seven point two" uye 0.25 se"zero point two five.")
z-m-13-07.thinking.0: Kutsanangura kuti nei nzira yekuverenga yakarurama
z-m-13-07.thinking.2: Kuedza kuwedzera kwakazara ndokusarudza huwandu hwako

z-m-13-07.s.s1.prompt: Chikonzero chakakodzera ndechipi chekuti kuverenga 7.2 × 0.25 se7.2 ÷ 4 kwakapa kukosha kumwe chete?
z-m-13-07.s.s1.hint.1: 1/4 ye7.2 imwe yezvikamu zvingani zvakaenzana ze7.2?
z-m-13-07.s.s1.r.a: Hazvisi zvakangoitika. Pane chikonzero chinobatanidza kuwanza ne0.25 nekugovanisa ne4.
z-m-13-07.s.s1.o.b: Kugovanisa kwakareruka kupfuura kuwanza, saka zvakanaka kuzviita saizvozvo.
z-m-13-07.s.s1.r.b: Kureruka chikonzero chekusarudza nzira, kwete chikonzero chekuti makosha akaenzana.
z-m-13-07.s.s1.o.c: Nokuti 0.25 inhamba ine nzvimbo mbiri dzedhesimali, saka unogona kugovanisa ne4.
z-m-13-07.s.s1.r.c: Hakusi nhamba dzose dzine nzvimbo mbiri dzedhesimali dzinogona kuchinjwa kuita kugovanisa nenhamba imwe. Unofanira kutarisa hunhu hwenhamba 0.25 pachayo.

z-m-13-02.title: Mutemo wekushandura fractions kuita decimals kuverenga: unobvumirwa kusvika papi?

z-m-13-02.goal: Tonga, uchigadzirisa chivimbo chako nguva imwe neimwe data itsva painosvika, kuti ma fractions api anopiwa chaizvo nemutemo wekushandura ma fractions kuita decimals neapi anopiwa zvinenge chete, uye unyore mamiriro iwayo senote yekuverengwa nemunun'una.
z-m-13-02.material: Seoha akati, "Kana uchiverenga uchisanganisa fractions nema decimals, zviri nyore kushandura ma fractions ose kuita decimals. Unogona kungonyora 1/3 se0.33." z-m-13-02.thinking.0: Kugadzirisa kutonga nechivimbo sezvo umboo huchikura

z-m-13-02.s.s1.prompt: Mhedzisiro dzekuverenga dzinoratidzwa rimwe nerimwe. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza kuti unoona sei mutemo waSeoha.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.hint.0: Padanho rimwe nerimwe, nyora mhedzisiro yakaverengwa nema decimals nemhedzisiro yakaverengwa nema fractions padivi pemumwe, uye uratidze kwakafanana nekwakasiyana.

z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Kuverenga kwekutanga ndi 1/4 + 0.5. Seoha akashandura 1/4 = 0.25 ndokuwana 0.25 + 0.5 = 0.75. Kana kwaverengwa nema fractions, 1/4 + 1/2 = 3/4, uye 3/4 ndi0.75.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Kuwana mhinduro imwe chete hakureve kuti zvakadaro kune ma fractions ose. 1/4 yaiva fraction inobuda chaizvo se0.25. Kuedza nema fractions mamwe ndiro danho rakarurama rinotevera.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Mhedzisiro dzekuverenga dzakafanana, saka mhinduro yakafanana kune fraction ipi neipi.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakabva pamuenzaniso mumwe wese kusvika ku "kune fraction ipi neipi." Funga kana pane ma fractions, senge 1/3, anoratidzika akasiyana kana akashandurwa kuita decimals.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Muenzaniso mumwe oga hauigoni kutiudza. Edza ma fractions mamwewo.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakanaka. Kuva nemuenzaniso mumwe wakarurama kwakasiyana ne "unogara uri wakarurama," saka unofanira kuedza zvakawanda.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Mutemo waSeoha wakashata. Kana ukashandura fraction kuita decimal, kukosha kunochinja.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kunyange kana 1/4 yakashandurwa kuita 0.25, kukosha hakuna kuchinja. Shanda kana pane ma fractions anochinja kukosha kana ukaashandura.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Kuverenga kunosanganisa ma fractions nema decimals hakugoni kuitwa nenzira ipi neipi.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Unogona kuverenga nekuita kuti vakodzere, fraction ne fraction kana decimal ne decimal. Mumuenzaniso uyu, nzira mbiri dzose dzaigoneka.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Kuverenga kwechipiri ndi 1/3 + 0.5. Seoha akashandura 1/3 = 0.33 ndokuwana 0.33 + 0.5 = 0.83. Kana kwaverengwa nema fractions, 1/3 + 1/2 = 5/6, uye 5/6 yakanyorwa se decimal ndi0.8333… (ma3 anoenderera nekusingaperi).
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Tinofanira kuona sei mhinduro yaSeoha ye0.83?
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Kuronga 0.8333… kusvika kune yechipiri decimal place kunopa 0.83. Saka kana mubvunzo uchibvunza "kusvika kune yechipiri decimal place," mhinduro yaSeoha inogona kugamuchirwa. Asi kukosha chaiko ndi5/6, uye 0.83 kukosha kunenge kudiki zvishoma pane iko. Unofanira kutanga watarisa kuti mubvunzo unoda kunyatsonaka kwakadii.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 5/6 haisi 0.83, saka mhinduro yaSeoha yakashata mune dzose nyaya.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Zvechokwadi kuti 5/6 inhamba yakasiyana ne0.83, asi kana mubvunzo uchibvunza "kusvika kune yechipiri decimal place," 0.83 inogona kuva mhinduro.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 0.83 ne0.8333… inhamba imwe chete chaizvo, saka hapana chikonzero chekuvasiyanisa.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: 0.8333… inhamba apo ma3 anoenderera nekusingaperi, saka yakakura zvishoma kupfuura 0.83. Hadzisi nhamba imwe chete.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Dzakasiyana sema value chaiwo, asi kana iri kusvika kune yechipiri decimal place, 0.83 zvakanaka zvakare.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakaparadzanisa makosha chaiwo nemakosha anenge uye wakaona kuti zvinoenderana nekunyatsonaka kunodiwa nemubvunzo.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Seoha akashandura kuita 0.33, ndiro dambudziko, saka 0.33 + 0.5 haigoni kuverengwa.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: 0.33 + 0.5 inogona kuverengwa. Dambudziko rekuti kukosha kwakashandurwa 1/3, 0.33, hakusi kukosha chaiko.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Kuverenga kwechitatu kuwedzera 1/3 katatu. Seoha akawana 0.33 + 0.33 + 0.33 = 0.99. Kana kwaverengwa nema fractions, 1/3 + 1/3 + 1/3 = 1.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Musiyano mudiki wakabva pakunyora 1/3 se0.33 wakakura kusvika ku0.01 sezvo wakawedzerwa katatu. Kana uchiramba uchiverenga, musiyano unogona kuunganidzwa, saka kana uchida kukosha chaiko, zvakachengeteka kuverenga nema fractions sezvazviri.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: 0.99 ne1 zvinenge zvakafanana, saka mutemo waSeoha wakanaka kupi nokupi.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Mashoko ekuti "zvinenge zvakafanana" anosiya kuti zvinofanira kuswedera padhuze zvakadii. Mubvunzo unoda kukosha chaiko, 0.99 haisi 1.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: 1/3 haigoni kunyorwa se decimal, saka haufaniri kusanganisa ma fractions nema decimals.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: 1/3 inogona kunyorwa se decimal umo ma3 anoenderera nekusingaperi. Kusanganisa hakurambidzwi pachako.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Mutemo waSeoha haumbobvira wakarurama kusvika zvino.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Mu 1/4 + 0.5, nzira yaSeoha yakapawo kukosha chaiko.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Makanganiso madiki anoramba achiunganidzwa, saka kana uchida kukosha chaiko, verenga nema fractions.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wakaverenga kuti zvikanganiso zvidiki zvinounganidzana sei nekuwedzera nekuwanza.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.reflect: Mutemo waSeoha waiita sewakarurama pakutanga here? Sezvo mienzaniso yaikura imwe neimwe, pfungwa dzipi dzakachinja uye dzipi dzakaramba dzakafanana? Unogona kutarisa chii kuti uzive kana uchida mutengo chaiwo kana mutengo unenge wakwana?

z-m-13-02.s.s2.model.0: Fraction inobuda chaizvo sedecimal, sa 1/4 kana 1/5, inoramba i chaiyo kana ukaichinja kuita decimal kuverenga. Asi 1/3 i 0.333… ichienderera nekusingagume, saka kunyora 0.33 i kufungidzira. Kana uchida mutengo chaiwo, verenga uchishandisa ma fractions.

z-m-13-05.title: Kupatsanura kutanga usati wapatsanura: nzira ipi inoshanda?
z-m-13-05.topic: Kupatsanura mixed numbers: unogona kupatsanura nhamba ipi neipi kuti uverenge here?

z-m-13-05.material:
Gaon naNarae vakatsanangura nzira dzekupatsanura kuverenga kupatsanura mixed numbers.
Gaon: "Patsanura mixed number inopatsanurwa kuita chikamu chenhamba yakazara nechikamu che fraction, upatsanure chimwe nechimwe nedivisor, wobva wawedzera."
Narae: "Ndinopatsanura divisor, iyo i mixed number, kuita chikamu chenhamba yakazara nechikamu che fraction, ndopatsanura nhamba inopatsanurwa nechimwe nechimwe, ndobva ndawedzera."
Izvi i mhedzisiro yevaviri ivavo kuedza nzira dzavo pamadambudziko maviri. (2 1/2 inoverengwa semaviri nehafu uye 12 1/2 segumi nemaviri nehafu.)
